usage: Usually refers to a decorative pin worn on clothing, like on a jacket, blouse, or dress.
Can sound a bit formal or old-fashioned in everyday speech; people also just say 針扣 or 徽章 in some contexts, depending on the item.
Commonly used when talking about fashion, accessories, gifts, or special occasions such as weddings and ceremonies.
As a noun, it is used on its own and does not change form; count it with 個 if you need to mention one item.
